purpose: Feature-module repair under frozen seed-matched graph potentials and common graph-only role weights; square RP surrogate, not exact native-feature matching.
base_generator: Exact original factor_real_graph_pilot training RNG sequence and seeds. Balanced shuffled labels; 3 uniformly drawn roles; degree parameter 4/8/12; signal U(.35,.8); preferred-class means .8 and -.8/(K-1); Gaussian noise sd .6. No PCFI call or native imputation.
train_replay: Original 512 tasks are replayed, not 512 newly independent graph tasks. A/B share raw graph, labels, Gaussian draws, context, source order, query truth and head initialization. Training CE supervises all original noncontext queries, including observed sources. Every task also has at least one feature-missing query.
projection: Independent task-seeded 16x16 Rademacher matrix / sqrt(16). Project raw values before observed-only RMS and clipping. No fitting. This changes covariance/conditioning and mean shape; not a pure single-cause manipulation.
normalization: Historical byte-identical float64 observed-only RMS with threshold1e-8, fallback1; clip[-10,10], outputfloat32, all hidden cells0. Empty-column count0 uses RMS1. No hidden feature statistics.
centroid_initialization: Center=observed mean. v_K=.36+.64/(K-1), tau0=sqrt((.64/(K-1))/v_K), sigma0=sqrt(.36/v_K). C_global3raw coefficients initialized0; C30->22->3 final layer0. location=mean+std*tanh(raw0); scale=.15+1.85*sigmoid(logit((base-.15)/1.85)+raw). Shared class-exchangeable conditional prior,41 normalized GH masses. No realized true centroid/covariance in forward.
graph_protocol: Inherited seed-matched original graph encoder/potentials are frozen. Graph-only BP24 role weights and p0 are common to all arms and feature modes; full/edge use their own graph-only definitions. Training uses full only; edge is separately reported evaluation, never per-dataset selection.
synthetic_final: 48 base graphs in N64/96/128 x K2/3/5/7 x4 order (N outer,K middle,repetition inner). Roles index%3; degree support[(index+index//3)%3], both balanced globally. Other generator draws use new fixed seeds. Label-blind reserved query is removed before source permutation. Six nested source counts round(N*(1-rate)); common Q excludes context and50%-source set. raw/projected six rates plus projected none/shuffle95. Orthogonal QR view at75/95 only first repetition in each of12 N,K cells.
synthetic_dev: 12 disjoint base graphs, one per N,K cell. Same all-rate/control/view rules for correctness and repairs only; all12 have the orthogonal diagnostic. No final outputs used in development.
synthetic_primary: Projected/full own-feature-missing queries;50/75/90/95 rates with source>=2. Equal rates within base graph, fixed3seeds averaged. C-B and C-C_global co-primary each97.5%two-sided paired percentile CI,5000 stratified base-graph bootstrap. Both lower>0 and means>=.01, absolute C-none>0 and NLL no worse than either comparator+.01. Report all rates/classes and negative outcomes.
boundary_conditions: 99/99.5 often source0/1; class-exchangeable centroid priors and common graph-only roles imply graph-only prediction. These are mandatory numerical structural checks, not evidence of unavailable class information being ignored.
real_protocol: Reuse exact existing75episodes and source/context/query masks. Full Cora/CiteSeer; fixed2000-node induced PubMed/Coauthors. All development data. Both full/edge and all3seeds; no target updates. Hash/identity-verified existing public/PCFI/FISF-PFN and twoLP predictions only; no new baseline training or winner selection.
integrity: No bank overwrite. Train raw observations/graphs/masks/context/query/truth must exactly match all512 historical saved train episodes. Generator-side audit stores true means/covariance/rank/moments separately; read() returns a strict visible-input whitelist. Final generation requires root source lock and checks PASS; final seed bank never retuned. Existing files are read-only.
scope: New seeds in the same shape/scalar family, not independent real holdout, unseen-schema or OOD validation. Conditional finite-grid approximate inference, not continuous Bayes exactness, published AMP reproduction or new feature-conditioned role posterior. Record failures and inherited/development compute.
